theGame.title: The Game
theGame.body: Whist is a trick-taking card game for 3 to 8 players. This app tracks your scores so you can focus on playing cards.

playersSeats.title: Players & Seats
playersSeats.body: Each player occupies a seat. Seat order is set at the start and stays fixed for the whole game. You can play with 3 to 8 players.

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.body: A game is played over as many rounds as you like. Each round, one player is the First Player (marked with ★). The First Player role rotates through all seats after each round.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.body: At the start of each round, each player declares their contract — the number of tricks they think they will win. Contracts are entered one player at a time, starting with the First Player.

results.title: Results
results.body: After playing the round at the table, each player enters how many tricks they actually won. Scores are calculated automatically.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.summary: Your total score is the sum of all round scores. Positive means you met your contracts; negative means you over- or under-bid.

winning.title: Winning
winning.body: The player with the highest total score at the end wins. Agree with your group beforehand on how many rounds to play, or play until someone reaches a target score.
